_meta.description: Emission and exposure factors for the CleanBreath AI Impact Engine. All values are sourced from peer-reviewed literature or government reports. NEVER use LLM estimates for numeric claims – always trace to this file.

transport._note: PM2.5 tailpipe emission factors in µg per vehicle-km. CO2 in grams per vehicle-km. Sources: USEPA MOVES2023 (US), CPCB vehicular emission standards (IN), IPCC AR6 WG3 Ch10.

assumptions: Average small petrol car, BS-VI norms
Average diesel car, BS-VI; PLACEHOLDER – verify with ARAI test data
CNG car, Delhi CNG price ~₹75/kg, 15 km/kg
Tailpipe PM2.5 from brake/tyre wear only. CO2 from India grid average 0.82 kg CO2/kWh × 0.116 kWh/km.
sources: CEA Grid Emission Factor 2022-23 (0.82 kg CO2/kWh)

assumptions: CNG auto, shared ride assumed (factor split downstream if needed)
Per-passenger, Delhi Metro load factor ~1200 pax/train, 6-car

exposure._note: Ambient-to-indoor infiltration factor and breathing rates for exposure calculation. Sources: WHO 2021, US EPA Exposure Handbook.

assumptions: Infiltration fraction F from Lawrence Berkeley Nat'l Lab (2004) residential infiltration study

cooking._note: Indoor PM2.5 emission rates from cooking. Sources: WHO Household Air Pollution Guidelines 2014, TERI India.

assumptions: Traditional mud chulha, 3-stone fire; 4 MJ per meal

indoor_air._note: Air purifier and filter sizing. Sources: AHAM, Meena et al. 2021.
indoor_air.cadr_note: Recommended CADR (m³/h) = Room volume (m³) × 0.75 for 4 ACH at PM2.5. Source: AHAM AC-1-2015.

assumptions: 4× MERV-13 20×20 filters + 20-inch box fan. Lab-measured CADR ~300 m³/h. 55% reduction in a 25 m² room from Bliss et al. 2021.
sources: Bliss et al. 2021 (preprint, Aerosol Science and Technology)

indoor_air.ventilation_window_guideline: Open windows for ventilation only when outdoor AQI < 50 (Green). At AQI 51–100 open briefly (<15 min) in the early morning before 7 AM. At AQI > 100, keep windows closed.
